basis: User-authorized, post-observation uniform rereview of four original answers; mathematical content rather than required vocabulary
R3_requirements: The answer establishes an effective, invertible complete-state representation of the original objects.
The answer correctly establishes a complete, closed and simplified pointwise dynamics in that representation, mathematically equivalent to the rotation structure.
A direct algebraic rewrite, complement or concatenation of already supplied coordinates can identify the normal form; a named binary encoding is not mandatory.
routine_completions_allowed: Eliminate a redundant boundary identity using equal row/column occupation sums already in the answer.
Verify the unique inverse by pairing occupied rows increasingly with occupied columns decreasingly.
Reorganize or complement already proved coordinate relations without adding a new substantive lemma.
completions_not_allowed: Invent or repair an essential correspondence that the answer did not establish.
Assume a statistic is preserved by an arbitrary conjugacy.
Apply an external theorem to a different operator or incompatible coordinates.
Credit unreported period, orbit-classification or enumeration theorems.
